where: The Lanternway — the four lit country lanes between the rim towns and the Vesper Crossroads
mood: The Walking Tune — the safe road home: a strolling shuffle of flute and reed, walking pizzicato and brushes, lamplight glinting on every post.
_note: Classic twin: assets/audio/midi/specs/lanternway-a.json (120 BPM, 4/4, G major, 32-bar AABA, the Vesper motif in bouncing form). Unconditioned (tempo matters); 114 BPM and a swung stroll so it reads cosier than dimglass-coast-a (120 BPM straight-eighth road with harp and string pad).
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
gentle swung shuffle, an unhurried strolling feel
sampled flute and soft reed lead playing the tune together
soft brushes on the snare with tambourine on the offbeats
small bright bell glints like lamplight on each lamp-post
cosy homely country lane at night between lit lamps, safe and contented
melody built on the hometown tune's rising lift, bouncing and skipping

sections.name: Stepping Out
sections.text: {the walking pizzicato bass and brushes start the stroll at once, a bell glint, and the flute and reed begin the tune on the second bar}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the walking tune: a bouncing, skipping melody on flute and reed, hummable and contented, over the swung walking bass}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the same melody again, the reed taking a harmony under the flute and bells glinting on the offbeats like passing lamps}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a gentle turn through C major and E minor, the reed alone with a warm skipping phrase, the brushes lighter, then a hop back toward the tune}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the walking tune returns, flute and reed together, warm and full; the last bar skips straight back into the theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
